title: 深夜走廊 EP01（16:9 电影质感示例）
style: Live-action, cinematic, shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool fluorescent corridor light with a warm practical lamp at the nurses' station, fine film grain
synopsis: 女律师林岚深夜在医院走廊截住周医生，逼问母亲病情被隐瞒的真相。

characters.name: 林岚
characters.identity_phrase: a woman in her early thirties with short black hair tucked behind her ears, a fitted black suit jacket over a white shirt, and a thin silver watch
characters.short_phrase: the woman in the black suit jacket
characters.sheet_phrase: a Chinese woman in her early thirties, about 168 cm and slim, with a sharp oval face, high cheekbones, straight dark brows, dark brown eyes, short black hair tucked behind her ears, a fitted black suit jacket over a white shirt, and a thin silver watch on her left wrist
characters.voice_phrase: a woman in her early thirties with a low, controlled voice and clipped, unhurried pace

characters.name: 周医生
characters.identity_phrase: a man in his fifties with grey-streaked short hair, thin gold-rimmed glasses, a white doctor's coat over a pale blue shirt, and a stethoscope around his neck
characters.short_phrase: the grey-haired doctor in the white coat
characters.sheet_phrase: a Chinese man in his fifties, about 175 cm and lean, with a long lean face, deep lines beside the mouth, tired hooded eyes, grey-streaked short hair, thin gold-rimmed glasses, a white doctor's coat over a pale blue shirt, and a stethoscope around his neck
characters.voice_phrase: a man in his fifties with a tired, gravelly voice and slow, measured delivery

scenes.name: 医院走廊
scenes.description: a long hospital corridor at night: pale green walls, a row of closed ward doors on the left, a dark nurses' station with a single warm desk lamp on the right, polished floor reflecting the overhead fluorescent tubes, an exit sign glowing green at the far end

props.name: 牛皮纸病历袋
props.description: a worn brown kraft-paper medical records envelope with a red hospital stamp in the corner

segments.summary: {lin_lan} steps into the path of {dr_zhou} in the night corridor and confronts him with a single question

shots.framing: a wide shot down the full length of the corridor from a low tripod height, the green exit sign small at the far end
shots.action: {dr_zhou} walks away from the camera toward the green exit sign with his head lowered and both hands buried in the pockets of his white coat. {lin_lan} steps out from behind the counter into his path and stops one metre in front of him with her arms at her sides and her weight on her back foot, and he halts. Both keep their lips closed and their eyes on each other while one fluorescent tube flickers faintly above the empty corridor
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.sound_cue: His rubber soles squeak twice on the polished floor and stop

shots.framing: a medium close-up of {lin_lan} over the right shoulder of {dr_zhou}, his shoulder soft in the foreground and her face sharp
shots.action: {lin_lan} tilts her chin up to look at {dr_zhou}, her jaw tight and her dark eyes steady, and speaks while he listens with his mouth closed, his shoulders stiffening under the white coat. A strand of hair slips loose over her ear and she leaves it
shots.lighting: The warm desk lamp behind her rims her short black hair while the cool tubes light her face
shots.performance: Her breathing slows before she speaks; afterwards she holds his gaze and waits with her hands at her sides.
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed

dialogue.speaker: lin_lan
dialogue.delivery: in a low, controlled voice, each word deliberate

segments.soundscape: The fluorescent tubes hum steadily overhead. A ward monitor beeps once far down the corridor.
segments.end_state: {lin_lan} stands at frame left facing {dr_zhou}, who stands at frame right with his back to the camera; both are still under the cool fluorescent light, the warm lamp behind her
segments.style: Live-action, cinematic, shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool fluorescent corridor light with a warm practical lamp at the nurses' station, fine film grain

segments.summary: {dr_zhou} takes out {prop_folder} and admits how long he has kept the truth from {lin_lan}

shots.framing: a medium close-up of {dr_zhou} from over the shoulder of {lin_lan}
shots.action: {dr_zhou} holds her gaze for a long beat, lowers his eyes to the floor and draws a slow breath. With his right hand he pulls {prop_folder} out from inside his white coat and holds it flat against his chest with both hands, the red hospital stamp facing the camera. His lips stay closed and his glasses catch a thin line of fluorescent light
shots.performance: His shoulders sink as he breathes out, and his fingers tighten on the edge of the envelope
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.sound_cue: The kraft paper rustles against the cotton of his coat

shots.framing: a close-up of the face of {dr_zhou}
shots.action: {dr_zhou} raises his eyes to {lin_lan} and speaks, his hands still pressing {prop_folder} to his chest, while she listens at the right edge of the frame with her mouth closed, only her chest rising with a slow breath
shots.lighting: The fluorescent tube above flares briefly across his gold-rimmed glasses
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed

dialogue.speaker: dr_zhou
dialogue.text: 从你母亲住院的第一天起。
dialogue.delivery: slowly and heavily, almost as a confession
dialogue.after_line: He closes his lips and lowers his eyes to {prop_folder}.

shots.framing: a close-up of the face of {lin_lan}
shots.action: {lin_lan} hears the words and her composure cracks: her eyes widen slightly, she presses her lips together and swallows once, and her gaze drops to the envelope before it lifts back to his face. She stays where she stands, breathing visibly
shots.lighting: Warm lamp light falls on the left side of her face and cool fluorescent light on the right
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot

segments.soundscape: The fluorescent hum continues unchanged. A single elevator chime sounds far away.
segments.end_state: {lin_lan} stands at frame left with her lips parted and her eyes glistening; {dr_zhou} stands at frame right holding {prop_folder} against his chest; the corridor lighting is unchanged
segments.continuity: {lin_lan} stands at frame left facing {dr_zhou}, who stands at frame right; both outfits are unchanged
segments.style: Live-action, cinematic, shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool fluorescent corridor light with a warm practical lamp at the nurses' station, fine film grain

places.at: in the middle of the corridor, a few steps past the nurses' station
behind the counter of the nurses' station

stagings.others: every ward door is closed and the rest of the corridor stays empty
